evidence: Carries Mining label, modifies BlockTemplateManager, interfaces::Mining, and mining.capnp to track block template memory usage.
rationale: Adds memory tracking for transactions retained by active block templates and exposes getMemoryLoad() over IPC for downstream miners like the Stratum v2 template provider. Ryanofsky notes the tracking provides 'almost everything needed to limit memory used by block templates', addressing an unmonitored memory footprint when templates pin evicted mempool transactions.
